component.name: Fossroot
component.summary: Manage DoD PKI CA certificate trust stores

description.p: Fossroot is an open-source, single-binary manager for DoD PKI CA certificate trust stores — a modern, auditable replacement for DISA's Windows-only InstallRoot utility. Accessing DoD websites from a personal computer requires the DoD PKI root and intermediate CA certificates in the machine's trust store; Fossroot installs, audits, and removes them.

Fossroot never ships certificates of its own: bundles are fetched live from DISA's official distribution point and cryptographically verified — the DISA-signed manifest is checked back to DoD root CAs pinned in the source code, and every certificate must chain to a pinned root or the bundle is rejected. It shows a full diff before any change and uninstalls completely.
Fossroot is an unofficial community tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency.
